cardBlurb: Airfoil analysis and build with the Aerodynamics Club.
title: RC Plane
body: I contributed to the design and build of a small RC plane with the Aerodynamics Club, a student run group exploring flight principles outside of coursework. I was not the lead on this one, so my part was smaller, mainly helping model the wing and fuselage in CAD and using XFLR5 to compare a few airfoil shapes before we picked one.

The final plane used a lightweight balsa wood frame reinforced with steel rod, covered in heat shrink film, with a modular motor mount so we could try different power setups without rebuilding the fuselage. It was a good introduction to how much aerodynamics theory actually shows up in a simple hobby build.
